Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** no user-visible reach. Since PR #12828 the page reads the served flat item, so users see labels. What is left is a tolerance arm with no measured producer, and fixtures in that shape only. That is a test-blindness cost, not a defect a user meets.
- **Premise read on `origin/main`:** `apps/console/src/pages/developer/FlowRunsPage.tsx:226-229` still reads `it?.spec?.name ?? it?.name`, `it?.spec?.label ?? it?.label` and `updatedAt ?? updated_at`.
- **Scope is the card's own:** the producer census first. If no server feeds `spec`-wrapped items, the arm and its fixtures go in one change; if one does, the card records it and a fixture in each shape stays.
- **Why `area:workflow`:** it is objectui#12783's page.

## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12876 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-17T10:41Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `3b75d79`, against the card's Expected, the triage note (`6227676358`) and the claim (`6232391422`, amended in place for two files the report measured).

- **Shape:** the body says `Fixes #12829`; the second line is `Clause-②: no`. The changeset has an empty frontmatter and releases nothing: `check-changeset-presence` requires one for any `apps/console/src` change, and no reachable behaviour changes.
- **The census first, as ruled** (objectstack `origin/main` `eda6f14b7b`): no server serves a `spec`-wrapped flow item.
  - `GET /api/v1/meta/flow` goes through the RestServer list route, `protocol.getMetaItems` and `readFlattenedMetaItems`. That serves registry definitions, `sys_metadata` overlay bodies and `metadataService.list`, merged flat. `decorateMetadataItem` only redacts and adds `_diagnostics`.
  - The runtime dispatcher's `/meta` list branch makes the same protocol call. `?preview=draft` runs the same body, merging draft bodies flat and tagged `_draft`.
  - `@objectstack/client`'s `meta.getItems` does not map items. objectui runs no MSW server.
  - The cloud runtime is NOT MEASURED: its code is not reachable from here.
  - A1 confirmed: the installed spec types `GetMetaItemsResponseSchema.items` as `unknown[]`, so no declared contract asks for `spec`.
- **The change:** `loadFlows` in `apps/console/src/pages/developer/FlowRunsPage.tsx` reads only the served flat item (`name`, `label`, `spec: it`). The never-rendered `updatedAt ?? updated_at` read and the `FlowItem.updatedAt` member go too. How users see labels (PR #12828) is unchanged.
- **Fixtures:** the four named sites now feed the served flat shape, plus `consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909` (its FlowRunsPage fixture fed the wrapped shape; the claim is amended for it). PR #12828's wrapped case is now the arm-gone pin.
- **Pins and ablation:** "a spec-wrapped item is not read: it lists no flow". Putting the `spec` arm back turns it red; the restore was proven by blob hash. Every test naming FlowRunsPage (19 files, 154 tests) is green; console type-check exits 0.
- **Trailers:** both commits carry only the model-free pair.
- **CI at head:** 33 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`, 36 runs), including Bundle Analysis (performance budget PASS). Not governed (path audit); 65 changed lines.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.

## Landed · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-17T10:54Z

PR #12876 merged through the merge queue as `1fe0a8d`, which is on `main`; `Fixes #12829` closed this card. Verified by content: all 7 of the PR's files on `main` are blob-identical to the accepted head `3b75d79`. The merge commit's message names no model.

What landed:
- The producer census found no server of `meta.getItems('flow')` that wraps an item in `spec` (objectstack REST list route, runtime dispatcher, `?preview=draft`, `@objectstack/client`; no MSW in objectui). The cloud runtime was not reachable from here: NOT MEASURED.
- The Flow Runs page's `loadFlows` therefore reads the served flat item only. The `spec` arm and the never-rendered `updatedAt` read are gone.
- The page's fixtures (five sites) feed the served shape, so a read that only works on a shape no server serves can no longer stay green, which is what hid objectui#12783.
- No reachable behaviour changes; the changeset releases nothing.

This seat now removes `pm:dispatched`.
